summary: First-party executable Provider plugin for fal.ai queued generation.
context_hints: The Provider id is clash.fal and account authentication is declared in providers/fal.json
The plugin performs one submit or one poll translation per invocation; scheduling and retries belong to the Host Durable Run Engine
Generated media is returned through the injected SDK upload capability and never downloaded into plugin business code

subdirectories.providers: fal.ai Provider declaration and API-key form.
subdirectories.src: Typed stdio entrypoint and native fal queue adapter.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned executable package and contribution declarations.
key_files.providers/fal.json: Provider metadata and account authentication form.
key_files.src/fal-adapter.ts: Native fal queue submit/poll and Hunyuan3D request translation.
